description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal role offers the opportunity to shape the future of patient care, ensuring the highest standards of clinical excellence and operational efficiency. If you are a compassionate leader with a strong commitment to quality, we encourage you to apply.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in overseeing all nursing operations, fostering a supportive environment for both staff and residents. This is an urgent opening, and we are looking to fill this role promptly with a candidate who is ready to make an immediate impact. Join a team that values your expertise and dedication.
requirements: Proven experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably in a skilled nursing facility
Strong understanding of long-term care regulations and compliance
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
Ability to manage and mentor a diverse nursing team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $85,000 to $95,000 annually, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Internal Medicine Physician to join a thriving community health center in Greenville, SC. This is an exceptional opportunity to provide high-quality patient care within a supportive environment, offering a highly competitive compensation package and excellent benefits.

This role comes with a non-negotiable base salary of $210,000 per year, complemented by a robust bonus structure that can reach up to $50,000. Enjoy great benefits, including generous Paid Time Off (PTO), and be part of a team that values a revamped compensation and raise structure. We are open to candidates seeking part-time, PRN, or contract arrangements, and welcome those open to travel or relocation.
salaryShort: $210,000+ per year with up to $50,000 in bonuses
requirements: Medical Doctor (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree
Board Certification/Eligibility in Family Medicine (preferred), Internal Medicine, or Med/Ped
Active South Carolina medical license or eligibility for licensure
salaryOrBonusInfo: This role offers a non-negotiable base salary of $210,000 per year, complemented by a robust bonus structure. This includes a $25,000 guaranteed bonus and an additional $25,000 potential bonus. A $9,000 portion of the bonus is available on payday one, contingent on signing a promissory note, and can be allocated towards relocation or sign-on incentives. Compensation is highly competitive, significantly exceeding the average for Family Medicine MDs in South Carolina.
